1: // Cosmic Runner – simple endless runner on canvas id="game"
2: (() => {
3:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
4:   if (!canvas) return;
5:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
6:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth || 800;
7:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight || 400;
8:   // initialize starfield particles
9:   const starCount = 80;
10:   const stars = [];
11:   for (let i = 0; i < starCount; i++) {
12:     stars.push({
13:       x: Math.random() * width,
14:       y: Math.random() * height,
15:       size: Math.random() * 2 + 1,
16:       speed: Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.2,
17:     });
18:   }
19:   // nebula particles for depth
20:   const nebulaCount = 30;
21:   const nebulae = [];
22:   for (let i = 0; i < nebulaCount; i++) {
23:     nebulae.push({
24:       x: Math.random() * width,
25:       y: Math.random() * height,
26:       r: Math.random() * 30 + 20,
27:       color: `rgba(100,0,${Math.floor(150 + Math.random()*105)},0.05)`
28:     });
29:   }
30: 
31:   // Audio setup using Web Audio API
32:   const AudioContext = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
33:   const audioCtx = new AudioContext();
34:   // Ensure audio starts after user interaction
35:   const resumeAudio = () => { if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume(); };
36:   window.addEventListener('click', resumeAudio, {once: true});
37:   window.addEventListener('keydown', resumeAudio, {once: true});
38: 
39:   function playTone(freq, duration = 0.1, type = 'square') {
40:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
41:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
42:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
43:     osc.type = type;
44:     osc.connect(gain);
45:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
46:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime);
47:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
48:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
49:     osc.start();
50:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
51:   }
52: 
53:   function playBoost() { playTone(200, 0.05, 'sawtooth'); }
54:   function playCollect() { playTone(600, 0.07, 'triangle'); }
55:   function playCollision() { playTone(100, 0.3, 'square'); }
56: 
57: 
58:   // Game state
59:   const ship = { x: 80, y: height / 2, w: 30, h: 15, vy: 0 };
60:   let isBoosting = false;
61:   const obstacles = [];
62:   const fuels = [];
63:   let fuel = 100;
64:   let score = 0;
65:   let lastTime = 0;
66: 
67:   const keys = {};
68:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => keys[e.key] = true);
69:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => keys[e.key] = false);
70: 
71:   function spawnObstacle() {
72:     const h = 20 + Math.random() * 30;
73:     obstacles.push({ x: width, y: Math.random() * (height - h), w: 20, h, speed: 3 + Math.random() * 2 });
74:   }
75:   function spawnFuel() {
76:     fuels.push({ x: width, y: Math.random() * (height - 15), r: 8, speed: 3 });
77:   }
78: 
79:   function update(dt) {
80:   // boost flag for rendering flame
81:   const boosting = keys.ArrowRight && fuel > 0;
82:   isBoosting = boosting;
83:   if (boosting) playBoost();
84:   // boost flag for rendering flame
85:   const boosting = keys.ArrowRight && fuel > 0;
86:   // move stars for parallax effect
87:   stars.forEach(s => {
88:     s.x -= s.speed;
89:     if (s.x < 0) {
90:       s.x = width;
91:       s.y = Math.random() * height;
92:       s.size = Math.random() * 2 + 1;
93:       s.speed = Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.2;
94:     }
95:   });
96:     // Ship control
97:     if (keys.ArrowUp) ship.vy = -4;
98:     else if (keys.ArrowDown) ship.vy = 4;
99:     else ship.vy *= 0.9;
100:     ship.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(height - ship.h, ship.y + ship.vy));
101:     if (keys.ArrowRight && fuel > 0) { // boost
102:       ship.x = Math.min(width - ship.w, ship.x + 6);
103:       fuel -= dt * 0.02;
104:     } else {
105:       ship.x = Math.max(0, ship.x - 1); // auto forward simulation
106:     }
107:     // fuel decay
108:     fuel = Math.max(0, fuel - dt * 0.005);
109: 
110:     // Spawn obstacles/fuel
111:     if (Math.random() < 0.02) spawnObstacle();
112:     if (Math.random() < 0.005) spawnFuel();
113: 
114:     // Move obstacles and check collision
115:     for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
116:       const o = obstacles[i];
117:       o.x -= o.speed;
118:       if (o.x + o.w < 0) { obstacles.splice(i, 1); score++; }
119:       // collision
120:       if (o.x < ship.x + ship.w && o.x + o.w > ship.x && o.y < ship.y + ship.h && o.y + o.h > ship.y) {
121:         playCollision();
122:         endGame();
123:         return;
124:       }
125:     }
126:     // Move fuels and collect
127:     for (let i = fuels.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
128:       const f = fuels[i];
129:       f.x -= f.speed;
130:       if (f.x + f.r < 0) fuels.splice(i, 1);
131:       else if (Math.hypot(f.x - ship.x, f.y - ship.y) < f.r + Math.max(ship.w, ship.h) / 2) {
132:         fuel = Math.min(100, fuel + 20);
133:         score += 5;
134:         fuels.splice(i, 1);
135:         playCollect();
136:       }
137:     }
138:   }

140:   function draw() {
141:     // starfield background with gradient
142:     const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, height);
143:     grad.addColorStop(0, '#001d3d');
144:     grad.addColorStop(1, '#000');
145:     ctx.fillStyle = grad;

147:     // draw nebulae (soft glows)
148:     nebulae.forEach(n => {
149:       ctx.fillStyle = n.color;
150:       ctx.beginPath();
151:       ctx.arc(n.x, n.y, n.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
152:       ctx.fill();
153:     });
154:     // draw moving stars
155:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
156:     stars.forEach(s => {
157:       ctx.fillRect(s.x, s.y, s.size, s.size);
158:     });
159:     // ship as triangle
160:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
161:     ctx.beginPath();
162:     ctx.moveTo(ship.x, ship.y + ship.h / 2);
163:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w, ship.y);

165:     ctx.closePath();

167:     // boost flame
168:     if (isBoosting) {
169:       ctx.fillStyle = 'orange';
170:       ctx.beginPath();
171:       ctx.moveTo(ship.x, ship.y + ship.h / 2);
172:       ctx.lineTo(ship.x - 10, ship.y + ship.h / 4);
173:       ctx.lineTo(ship.x - 10, ship.y + (3 * ship.h) / 4);
174:       ctx.closePath();
175:       ctx.fill();
176:     }
177:     // obstacles as asteroids (grey with slight gradient)
178:     obstacles.forEach(o => {
179:       const radius = Math.min(o.w, o.h) / 2;
180:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(o.x + radius, o.y + radius, radius * 0.2, o.x + radius, o.y + radius, radius);
181:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#aaa');
182:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#555');
183:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
184:       ctx.beginPath();
185:       ctx.arc(o.x + radius, o.y + radius, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);

188:     // fuel cells with glow effect

192:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#008');

198:     // UI
199:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';

201:     ctx.fillText(`Fuel: ${Math.floor(fuel)}`, 10, 20);
202:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 10, 40);
203:   }
204:

206:     const dt = (timestamp - lastTime) / 16; // roughly normalize to 60fps
207:     lastTime = timestamp;
208:     update(dt);
209:     draw();
210:     if (running) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
